resolution_notes: base_url: incorrect; production is region-specific — US/CA global-api.afterpay.com (docs: https://developers.afterpay.com/afterpay-online/reference/api-environments). auth_type: basic — HTTP Basic with Merchant ID + Secret Key (https://developers.afterpay.com/afterpay-online/reference/authentication). example: bare GET https://api.afterpay.com/ is not documented; use authenticated region host + /v2/configuration (same API environments + auth pages).
